name: Mark K. Cox
role: Sr. VP, Chief Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Engineering Officer, Eastman
bio: Mark K. Cox is Senior Vice President, Chief Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Engineering Officer for Eastman Chemical Company. Mark has responsibility for Eastman's global manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering and construction operations. During his career at Eastman, Mark has served in a variety of management positions, including various leadership roles within the Commercial, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Technology areas. Mark holds a B.S. degree in chemical engineering from the University of Tennessee and an M.B.A. from Northwestern University’s Kellogg School of Management.
